Stage-sized viewport uniforms; native top-row depth for AIR FragCoord and explicit lower-left storage for projected Coarse/Fog UV. Preview: zero sampled EnvironmentForces wind, static map-start environments, camera used for local avatar, neutral unbaked card lighting, no Visibility occlusion, water/fog-volume/transparent-list/bloom/motion-blur inputs zero, static opaque motion with original temporal resolve; deterministic editor rand31 stream with native conversion, explicit preview composed-HDR geometric-mean exposure and sRGB display transfer. Native opaque RGBA32F converted once to half RTE; original per-draw Metal half rounding/game image parity remain unverified.
